messages:
alex.k (Sales): Hey team — Acme POC needs to kick off next Mon. Their checklist: Hosted API keys for devs, dedicated pool for load tests, optional Private/VPC deployment for sensitive data, audit log export to their Splunk + S3 using their KMS, and answers for a security questionnaire. Can we confirm what's possible, any blockers, and a short how-to for the Splunk syslog forwarder? Timeline: start Mon 3/9. :wave:

sam.w (Solutions Eng): quick summary: all feasible but with caveats. Hosted API keys work for devs (scoped keys, rate-limited). Dedicated pool for POC yes (short-term reserved). Private/VPC requires infra onboarding + infra ticket. For logs: we support S3 delivery of structured audit logs + syslog forwarding for Splunk. CMK customer‑managed keys supported for S3 encryption.

marta.s (Security): From security side — we'll need the completed vendor security questionnaire before granting Private/VPC access. SOC2 artifacts can be shared under NDA. Important: we don't store customer plaintext secrets in logs; API key usage shows key id and actor but not the raw key. For PII redaction: we can enable automatic redaction on the audit stream, but need to agree on redaction rules up front. Also require DPA signed for any PII processing.

jing.li (Infra Eng): infra notes: 
- Dedicated POC: provision a temporary GPU pool (we typically ask for a 4–8 week window). Need a signed SOW or PO to reserve capacity.
- Private: requires VPC peering or private link + a small customer-managed control plane config. We'll need a CIDR range, egress rules, and an infra contact to do the VPN/peering.
- KMS: we support using customer's AWS KMS CMK for S3 object encryption and we can accept KMS grants. We'll need: KMS key arn, an IAM role ARN we can assume, and a KMS key policy grant for Redwood's service principal.
- Logs: two options: (1) structured audit logs -> S3 bucket (recommended for long-term retention), (2) syslog forwarder -> Splunk HEC or syslog endpoint for near-real-time. Default POC retention on our side is 90 days unless Customer requests extension.

sam.w (Solutions Eng): sample syslog snippet for Splunk (replace host/port/token):
```
# forwarder config example (rsyslog)
*.* @splunk.example.com:514;RSYSLOG_SplunkFormat
# or HEC curl post to HEC endpoint
curl -k -H 'Authorization: Splunk YOUR_HEC_TOKEN' https://splunk.example.com:8088/services/collector -d '{"event":"<audit log json>"}'
```
And example for creating a scoped API key via our admin API (do NOT paste real keys in slack):
```
POST /v1/orgs/:org/api-keys
{
  "name": "acme-dev-key-1",
  "scopes": ["inference:read","inference:write"],
  "expires_at": "2026-04-30T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Note: scoped keys show an id in audit logs; the raw secret is only shown once at creation.

alex.k (Sales): Good — what's the pricing ask we should expect for a ~4 week Dedicated POC and for on‑prem/private onboarding (fast lane)? Need a ballpark to include in proposal.

daniel.r (Account Exec): Ballpark numbers to give Acme: Hosted POC (self-serve devs + limited quotas) — we can cover with free credits up to X tokens (we'll confirm credit amount after legal). Dedicated short-term POC (4 weeks) — typical minimum $18k–$40k depending on GPU profile and SLA (N1/N2 class). Private/VPC onboarding + infra support — setup fee $10k–$25k (one-time) depending on complexity + monthly platform seat/ops premium. These are estimates; final pricing requires SOW.

marta.s (Security): blockers checklist for Private/P2P: 
- Completed security questionnaire + contact to run a security call (30–45m)
- DPA signed (if handling EU data)
- Approved list of Redwood engineers who will access logs/console during POC
- SSO/SCIM or at least invite-only accounts for audit traceability
If any of these are missing we escalate to legal.

alex.k (Sales): Perfect. Action items: Sam, can you draft the syslog/S3/KMS steps and a short runbook for the customer? Jing, can you create the internal infra ticket template for Dedicated/Private onboarding and list required artifacts? Marta, please attach the questionnaire we can send to Acme and available SOC2 excerpt list. Daniel, I'll ask procurement for a rough PO this afternoon.

sam.w (Solutions Eng): on it — I'll drop a 1‑pager + runbook in this thread by EOD. :thumbsup:

jing.li (Infra Eng): creating infra ticket now and cc'ing infra-bot — will include required CIDR, IAM role, KMS arn, and expected maintenance windows.

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-2026 created: "POC - Acme - Private/VPC onboarding" assigned to jing.li, due 2026-03-06.

marta.s (Security): attached questionnaire (sending off-thread via secure link) and available times for a security call: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

alex.k (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'll sync with Acme and push for the questionnaire & initial PO. Will update thread with their answers. :rocket:
